reason: Adds the remaining wave-1 tools under the frozen protocol, before their first capture.
isolation: Each attempt runs in its own container with the same flags as adeu (amendment 2). A runner inside the container drives only the tool's public interface and prints one JSON status line; the host adapter copies the output out.

docx-cli.license: MIT (package also ships LGPL-3.0 and NOTICES for bundled components)
docx-cli.mapping: replace [--track] in the body; plain on a document with tracking on: track-changes off, replace, track-changes on; K7h: headers set --text with the whole new header text [--track] (the tool applies a header-text replacement directly); K7n: footnotes edit --at fnN [--track] (body edits are applied directly); K5: comments list, reply --at cN, add --anchor; K6: track-changes list --json then apply --accept/--reject tcN; K0 unsupported (no save command). DOCX_AUTHOR and DOCX_CLI_NOW are set to the editor and the declared date.

office-word-mcp.mapping: plain replacements with search_and_replace; K2 with format_table_cell_text(text_content=the new cell text), the case found on 2026-09-23; tracked replacements, K0, K5 (comment tools only read) and K6 unsupported.

docx-mcp.mapping: DocxDocument open/save(backup=False); body replacements with replace_text (tracked flag) on the paraId its own search_text returns; K7h with edit_header_footer; K7n plain with update_footnote (tracked unsupported: no tracked mode); K5 with reply_to_comment and add_comment (whole paragraph); K6 with accept_change/reject_change. Comment, footnote and revision w:id values are read from the source XML.

docxengine.mapping: JSON-lines CLI: docx_open, docx_replace (track_changes per mode; it searches the main body), docx_comment list/reply/add (add anchors a whole paragraph found with docx_search), docx_revision list/accept/reject, docx_save. DOCXENGINE_AUTHOR and DOCXENGINE_FIXED_DATE are set to the editor and date.
